title: Identifying and burying George; her faith after the loss
summary: She and a cousin identified him at the morgue, buried him cheaply, and she says the Lord stood by her.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
